per_key_checks.terminology: तस्वीर is the catalogue's established word for a user-facing image (ui.chat.canonical.image_label = 'तस्वीर'; ui.chat.image_actions.copy_image/copy_image_url/expand_image all तस्वीर). पेस्ट is the living loan the sibling key already uses. No divergence from the hi style guide's kept-loan list (टोकन, कैश, फ़ाइल ...).
per_key_checks.fit: No maxCells/maxChars on this key. 18 codepoints / 15 base clusters, shorter than the adjacent 'पेस्ट की गई फ़ाइल' (20-cluster budget on pasted_file); no overflow concern for a 100px tile caption.
per_key_checks.assessment: Clean. Meaning, register and the sibling construction all match.

per_key_checks.mechanical: Placeholder {name} byte-exact and alone in its braces; no ICU argument, plural or select; no markup; NFC; no invisible characters; single U+0020 on each side of the placeholder; no trailing stop. Identical to the source's one placeholder.
per_key_checks.meaning: Names the asset whose actions menu will open; it is not a command to act on the file. The postpositional genitive carries the relation, and {name} is inserted verbatim — never translated or declined.
per_key_checks.grammar_for_any_insert: की agrees with कार्रवाइयाँ (feminine plural), NOT with the inserted name, and the phrase is postpositional. Verified by splicing ten arbitrary names (Latin, Devanagari, CJK, spaces, quotes, apostrophe, parentheses, comma, a 120-char name, a name that is itself a Hindi genitive phrase 'बैठक की रिकॉर्डिंग.mp3'): every result was 'की कार्रवाइयाँ'-terminated with single spacing and no artifact. No case/gender/number of the inserted string can break it.
per_key_checks.terminology: Byte-identical to the existing hi value for the SAME English string: ui.chat.canonical.link_toolkit.actions_for = '{name} की कार्रवाइयाँ'. The same '{possessor} की कार्रवाइयाँ' menu form is the catalogue's established one (ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.row_actions '{name} की कार्रवाइयाँ'; ui.projects project_board.actions_for_displayname; ui.browser.browser_tab_strip.actions_for; ui.teamBridge.actions.label 'संदेश की कार्रवाइयाँ'). The alternative '{name} के लिए कार्रवाइयाँ' also exists in hi (ui.library.menu.asset_actions_label) — so both constructions are native here and the catalogue is not uniform; this key follows the byte-identical precedent for its own English sentence, which is the stronger consistency argument. Not a divergence.
per_key_checks.assessment: Clean. Byte-identical to the existing rendering of the same English phrase, and the construction survives any inserted user string.

per_key_checks.mechanical: Placeholder {label} byte-exact, alone in its braces, no ICU construct, single U+0020 after it, no markup, NFC, no invisible characters, no trailing stop. Source and target have the same one placeholder.
per_key_checks.meaning: Accessible name of a clip's seek slider: names the playback position of THIS clip, not a play/pause action. 'की प्लेबैक स्थिति' = '...'s playback position'. The clip label is retained verbatim, per the context note.
per_key_checks.why_playback_is_stated: The hi word स्थिति alone means status/state — 19 existing hi values use it that way ('कनेक्शन की स्थिति', 'पढ़ने की स्थिति', 'हब की स्थिति' ...). Rendering '{label} की स्थिति' alone would read as the clip's STATUS and would be wrong for a seek slider, so stating प्लेबैक is a required disambiguation, not an added idea: the English context note says this string 'names playback position'. It also uses the catalogue's own existing word for playback position, ui.chat.attachments.playback_position = 'प्लेबैक की स्थिति'.
per_key_checks.linking_particle: The new value composes the compound as 'प्लेबैक स्थिति' while the standalone key has 'प्लेबैक की स्थिति'. Both use the same two terms; only the linking particle differs, and the pinned UI glossary's rule is explicit: 'Preferred renderings are citation forms. Inflect them naturally in a sentence ... A row is violated by a different term, not by a grammar form.' Nested 'की ... की' would be clunky here, so carrying one genitive from {label} is the natural form. Not a term divergence and not a finding.
per_key_checks.grammar_for_any_insert: की agrees with स्थिति (feminine) and {label} is a bare possessor, so any inserted title works, including one that already ends in a genitive phrase. Verified by the same ten-name splice: every result was 'की प्लेबैक स्थिति'-terminated, single-spaced, no artifact.
per_key_checks.fit: No maxCells/maxChars on this key (audio.play_label/pause_label carry maxCells 40; this one does not). 25 codepoints / 21 base clusters; accessible name only.
per_key_checks.assessment: Clean. Accurate, disambiguating, and built from the locale's own existing term.
